minor.issue: First uncached GET of a show consistently takes ~15s while subsequent GETs return in ~100ms. Reproduced 3× via curl in an isolated shell. Suspect the `background_tasks.add_task(_trigger_radioplayer_schedule_push)` at shows.py:1079 or a downstream sync call is blocking the response before flush. Not related to iter-167 fix — but bumped test timeouts from 15s→45s so pytest can pass. Worth a separate investigation.

rca of the issue: iter-166 root cause: `currentEndpoint = endpoints.find(e => e.id === veId)` returned undefined on first render because the `endpoints` array is fetched lazily (only when the popover opens). After a page reload, before the user clicks the pill, the list is empty → currentEndpoint=undefined → pill falls back to the neutral 'Send to Video Endpoint' label even though has_video=true and video_endpoint_id is set. Fix (option A, backend enrichment): _enrich_show_video_endpoint denormalises the endpoint name into every ShowResponse via a single find_one on db.video_endpoints. The frontend fallback at line 1341 now resolves to `{ id: veId, name: show.video_endpoint_name }` on first render, so the pill label survives page reload. Verified: pill reads 'TEST_iter167_Vimeo_GRK' both before and after page.reload().
